mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET login_ip = #{ip}, login_date = #{time} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT account.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(account.nick_name, ''), account.user_name) AS nickName, account.dept_id AS deptId, department.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user account LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.dept_id = account.dept_id AND department.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = '0' WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' ORDER BY account.user_id

SELECT account.user_id FROM sys_user account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND account.user_id > #{afterUserId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role ON role.role_id = membership.role_id AND role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.deleted = 0 AND role.role_key IN ('admin', 'hr') WHERE membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = account.user_id ) ORDER BY account.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
